files.analytics.sql:
-- SQL Analytics Template - AI Provider OS
-- Queries com JOINs, agregações, window functions

-- 1. Total vendas por mês
SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) as mes,
    COUNT(*) as total_pedidos,
    SUM(total) as receita,
    AVG(total) as ticket_medio
FROM orders
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 months'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC;

-- 2. Top clientes
SELECT 
    u.id,
    u.name,
    COUNT(o.id) as pedidos,
    SUM(o.total) as gasto_total,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.total) DESC) as ranking
FROM users u
JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id
GROUP BY u.id, u.name
ORDER BY gasto_total DESC
LIMIT 10;

-- 3. Produtos sem vendas
SELECT p.id, p.name
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE oi.id IS NULL;

-- 4. Taxa conversão por dia
SELECT 
    DATE(created_at) as dia,
    COUNT(*) as visitas,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN converted THEN 1 END) as conversoes,
    ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN converted THEN 1 END)::numeric / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) as taxa
FROM visits
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC;
